CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "analytics_data_streams" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "property_id" UUID,
  "display_name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "stream_type" TEXT,
  "external_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "measurement_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "firebase_app_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "default_uri" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "bundle_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "package_name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "status" TEXT,
  "enhanced_measurement" BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "analytics_events" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "property_id" UUID,
  "event_name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "client_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "user_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "params" TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
  "event_timestamp" TIMESTAMP,
  "status" TEXT,
  "sent_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "error_message" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "retry_count" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "non_personalized_ads" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  "session_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "page_path" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "page_title" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "user_agent" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "ip_address" TEXT DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "analytics_properties" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "display_name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "provider" TEXT,
  "external_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "measurement_id" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "api_secret" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "site_domain" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "time_zone" TEXT DEFAULT 'America/Los_Angeles',
  "currency_code" TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',
  "industry_category" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "service_level" TEXT DEFAULT 'STANDARD',
  "status" TEXT,
  "last_sync_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "provider_metadata" TEXT DEFAULT '{}'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "analytics_reports" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" UUID,
  "property_id" UUID,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "description" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "dimensions" TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
  "metrics" TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
  "date_range_start" TEXT DEFAULT '7daysAgo',
  "date_range_end" TEXT DEFAULT 'today',
  "dimension_filter" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "metric_filter" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "order_by" TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
  "max_results" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "status" TEXT,
  "frequency" TEXT,
  "last_run_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "next_run_at" TIMESTAMP,
  "result_data" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "row_count" INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  "last_error" TEXT DEFAULT ''
);
